Inquiry Commissions Ordinance
Chapter 52, 1955 Revised Edition
Commission
N 20
G.N. No. S 1408/1960
REVISED EDITION 1990
( )
[15 July 1960]
ELIZABETH THE SECOND, by the Grace of God of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland and of Her Other Realms and Territories QUEEN, Head of the Commonwealth, Defender of the Faith.
By His Excellency Inche YUSOF BIN ISHAK, Yang di-Pertuan Negara of the State of Singapore.
Whereas it is provided by the Inquiry Commissions Ordinance that it shall be lawful for the Yang di-Pertuan Negara, whenever he shall deem it advisable, to issue a Commission appointing one or more Commissioners to enquire, inter alia into any matter in which an inquiry would, in the opinion of the Yang di-Pertuan Negara, be for the public welfare:
And whereas I am of the opinion that in view of the increasing expenditure on Personal Emoluments and Other Charges Annually Recurrent in the public service and the need for economy an inquiry should forthwith be made by Commissioners so appointed in accordance with the following terms of reference:
1.To examine the expenditure detailed in the Ordinary Estimates concerning Personal Emoluments and Other Charges Annually Recurrent, department by department, and to make recommendations to effect economies; and
2.To inquire into procedure and organisation in order to ascertain to what extent any simplification of work, better utilisation of existing services and re-deployment of existing staff will bring about both economy and increased efficiency.
Now, therefore, I, YUSOF BIN ISHAK, hereby appoint the following persons, namely:
Dr. B. R. Sreenivasan (Chairman);
Mr. Ee Peng Liang;
Mr. C. C. Lew;
Mr. Yap Twee;
Mr. Jamit Singh; and
Mr. Evan Wong;
to be Commissioners and hereby authorise the said Commissioners to conduct such inquiry in the manner hereinafter directed:
